name: obs
description: Personal Obsidian notes management, driven by deterministic Python scripts (no model call): the Documents/ organiser tree (cache-based index, check, fix, sort, destinations); filler (survey, sort, index, merge, clean); project (create, invoice, export-rag); mail (rules-based triage of exported mail).

interface.longDescription: Manage an Obsidian vault through deterministic scripts for the Documents/ tree, content directories, project notes, and exported mail.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this directory is well organised
Inventory this folder and tell me what to reduce
Triage this mail branch against its rules
